source: Chrono Divide v0.84.0, Options > Keyboard (defaults), read 2026-09-24. Gameplay options: Attack/Move Button = Left Mouse, Right Click Scrolling = On, Mouse Acceleration = On.
note: The game warns that some hotkeys are only captured in full-screen, but in windowed Chrome (one tab) a staged Ctrl+1..9 does create a team: probe 2026-09-26, Ctrl+2 put the team badge on the MCV. Alt focuses the browser menu, so the agent never sends Alt.

structure_tab.effect: Structure tab; also picks up a completed building for placement.

defense_tab.effect: Armory (defense) tab; also picks up a completed defense for placement.

type_select.effect: Selects units by type; works with mixed selections.

goto_radar_event.effect: Cycles the camera through recent EVA events.

waypoints.effect: Hold while clicking a finite route; release to enqueue it. Stop the selected squad first when replacing its route. Chrono Divide v0.84 rejects duplicate nodes and does not support looping patrols.
waypoints.agent: Step.route owns Z and releases it on interruption; the isolated browser uses the Waypoints button and a Z tap to exit.

select_team.effect: Pressed twice 60 ms apart it also centers the camera on the team (probe 2026-09-26; ~200 ms apart did not).

create_team.agent: used: Ctrl+1 saves the field army at each attack wave (modifier held in stages)

center_team.agent: refused: Alt (the double tap does the same)

center_view.effect: Centers the view on the selection.

deploy.agent: refused: packs the construction yard with MCV Repacks

repair_mode.agent: Used only by verified repair tasks for recognized damaged owned buildings; right-click exits and inactive icons are checked.
